summary: Sono Group N.V., a smaller reporting company listed on Nasdaq, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 283,500 ordinary shares at a purchase price equal to the prior day's closing bid ($2.67 on August 28, 2026), for aggregate proceeds of $756,945. The shares are offered to accredited investors and qualified institutional buyers pursuant to a share purchase agreement dated August 31, 2026. Delivery is expected on September 2, 2026. This ordinary equity financing is a routine registered direct offering under an existing shelf, not a special situation.
